description: Paride Crisafulli publishes the code and cleaned data used to forecast emergency-department arrivals at Son Espases University Hospital in the Balearic Islands. The archived repository contains a Jupyter notebook, training, validation and test visit series, and separate post-COVID files. Explanatory inputs describe calendar effects, resident and tourist populations, and daily weather forecasts. Hospital records cover 26 December 2015 to 31 December 2022, with the pandemic period excluded from the analysis. Zenodo provides the January 2026 software release as a ZIP archive under MIT, free of charge. Raw hospital data are not included and require a separate request to the health service. The cleaned series can inform hospital-demand scenarios, while the code permits comparison of forecasting methods. Generalisation outside this hospital remains unknown. No related catalogue resource is identified by the deposit.
